name: Gakkyuu Gangu
source:
Main heroine Chie passes exams to enter special class where only excellent students study. But her nightmare begins from this day. She is chosen by male students of this class to comfort them. Even pregnancy can't stop her everyday hell.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角千惠通过考试，进入只有优秀学生就读的特别班。然而，她的噩梦从这一天开始。班里的男学生选中她来满足自己的欲望。就连怀孕也无法阻止她日复一日的地狱生活。
